description_html:
92 Christmas activities for ages 4-8.

  • 20 Christmas word searches (across and down only, great for new readers)
  • 16 Christmas dot-to-dots: tree, stocking, gingerbread man, sleigh and more
  • 12 picture sudokus (no reading or numbers needed)
  • 20 mazes from easy to tricky
  • 24 big, bold Christmas coloring pages
  • All answers at the back

A perfect stocking stuffer.
